title: Too Old at 31: This Job Pays $148,080
description:
Too old at 31. For this job, you are.

Sources:
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Air traffic controllers 53-2021, annual median wage, May 2025: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000053202113
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: 10th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000053202111
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: 90th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000053202115
- Wikipedia: Air traffic controller: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_traffic_controller
- FAA: Aviation careers: https://www.faa.gov/jobs/career_fields/aviation_careers

BLS May 2025 (OEWS): median $148,080; 10th percentile $78,420; 90th percentile $215,610. FAA rule: trainees start at the academy by their 31st birthday; mandatory retirement at 56 (Wikipedia). FAA: more than 14,000 controllers, 2.9 million daily passengers. Median = half earn more, half earn less. Not financial advice.
